advancement_basis: First finish the already-running two-seed nominal/white_v2 complete-turn regressions; do not duplicate probes.

No replacement arbitrary percentage/quality hard gate is introduced. Significant systematic wrong direction, severe regression, actual task/model/data failure, or missing evidence still prevents advancement.
Before DR, perform or reuse explicitly matched actual world-stage closeout reports at a safe full-save boundary; disclose remaining direction errors.
